name: Magnetic Interference
description: Simulates magnetic distortion using unified displacement fields and alpha translucency blending. Features ripple shockwave interference, gravity-well mouse attraction, canonical bass envelope, beat-pulsed magnetic field, mids-driven swirl and chromatic rotation, treble sparkle overlay, audio-amplified ripples, temporal feedback smearing, depth-aware compositing, chromatic aberration, and mouse-velocity trail drag.
